sections.label: Oklahoma Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act (Sections 59-2095 et seq.)
sections.text:
Title 59. Professions and Occupations
§59-2095. Short title.

Sections 3 through 29 of this act shall be known and may be cited as the "Oklahoma Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act".
Added by Laws 2009, c. 190, § 3, eff. July 1, 2009.
